flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearch,useSearchParams} (lookup per Court Mention Date); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/courtmention). State Courts pagination list, matching and tally: no code in any of the six repos.
note: The story asks OCMS to match the cases on the court mention date against the State Courts pagination list. There is no code that receives a State Courts pagination list (SFTP/file), no matching logic and no tally result. Only the notice lookup by Court Mention Date range in the Notice Search UI exists (server side cannot be verified from the repo). The story status is blank, so the requirement is not given; traced normally. Grep returned 0 hits in the six repos (excluding the stale cronservice folder) for the synonyms: pagination list, paginationList, state court, State Courts, judiciary, eLitigation, ROMS, CSD batch, court sftp. The word 'pagination' only appears for ordinary list/grid paging. CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info) is not credited: those are inbound endpoints for CAS/PLUS, not a check run by the Court Processing Officer.
recommendation: Claim only the case lookup per mention date (UI). Receiving the State Courts list and the matching are not built.

steps.step: OCMS receives the State Courts pagination list for the mention date
steps.detail: Grep returned 0 hits in the six repos (excluding the stale cronservice folder) for the synonyms: pagination list, paginationList, state court, State Courts, judiciary, eLitigation, ROMS, CSD batch, court sftp. The word 'pagination' only appears for ordinary list/grid paging. There is no State Courts controller/cron/SFTP in thirdpartyapi/ocmsadminprivateapi; thirdpartyapi only holds other agency webhooks (e.g. axsNopo). The SFTP partner cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS fetches the OCMS cases scheduled on the mention date
steps.detail: useSearch.getNoticesByCourtMention calls GET courtmention with mention_date[$gte]/[$lte] (useSearch.ts:99-113, invoked in useSearchParams.tsx:232-241). The /v1/courtmention resource only appears in the authorization list (api-authorization.properties:23); there is no courtmention controller, entity or repository in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi/thirdpartyapi (grep courtmention, court_mention, mentionDate). The server side and its table therefore cannot be verified from the repo; a CRUD gateway outside the repo may provide it.

steps.step: OCMS matches the OCMS cases against the State Courts list
steps.detail: No compare/match/reconcile/tally logic between two sets of cases in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi (grep pagination list, tally, reconcil, mismatch, compare court). The only court hit in authorization (api-authorization.properties:23) is a path list.

steps.step: OCMS determines whether the cases in both files tally
steps.detail: No tally result, flag or 'tally/not tally' status is stored or returned; there is no DTO/entity for it in the six repos.
